description: The plot illustrates the training loss over time for two different configurations, with the x-axis representing training time in seconds (ranging from 0 to 250,000 s, linear scale, with major ticks every 50,000 s) and the y-axis representing loss (ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, linear scale, with major ticks every 0.05 units). The purple line with triangle markers, labeled “Vanilla,” shows a smooth, gradually decreasing loss from approximately 2.75 at 0 s to about 2.50 at 250,000 s. The red line with circular markers, unlabeled in the legend but visually distinct, starts at approximately 2.72 at 0 s and decreases more steeply than the purple line, reaching around 2.49 by 250,000 s. A green dashed horizontal line at loss = 2.50 and vertical lines at approximately 200,000 s and 250,000 s highlight a region where the red line achieves the same loss as the purple line 1.26× faster, as annotated by the “1.26×” label between the vertical lines. The gridlines are light gray and evenly spaced, aiding in visual alignment of data points.
